title: Home Team’s Readiness to Deal with Multiple Concurrent Civil Unrest Incidents
what_it_is: Home Team’s Readiness to Deal with Multiple Concurrent Civil Unrest Incidents

sections.label: Preventing civil unrest escalation
sections.summary: Multiple concurrent civil unrest incidents will stretch Home Team resources, so the primary strategy is preventing assemblies or processions from escalating into civil unrest.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Multiple concurrent civil unrest incidents will stretch the resources of the Home Team.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Our primary strategy must, therefore, be to put in place measures to prevent any assembly or procession from escalating into civil unrest in the first place.

sections.label: Public Order and Safety Act
sections.summary: The Public Order and Safety (Special Powers) Act was introduced in 2018 to give Police powers to deal with serious threats to public security and order.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Public Order and Safety (Special Powers) Act (POSSPA) was introduced in 2018 to ensure that the Police have powers to deal effectively with serious threats to public security and order.

sections.label: Crisis management and police response
sections.summary: The Homefront Crisis Management System would coordinate a whole-of-Government response, and Police frontline first responders are trained and equipped for public order situations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In the event of multiple concurrent civil unrest incidents, the Homefront Crisis Management System would be activated to coordinate a whole-of-Government response.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: As for operational capabilities, the Police’s frontline first responders are trained and equipped to deal with public order situations.

sections.label: Mobilising police resources
sections.summary: Police have procedures to amass on and off duty resources, recall Police National Servicemen and tap Volunteer Special Constabulary officers, remaining committed to law and order.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Should there be a surge in capacity required to manage incidents, the Police have procedures in place to amass both on and off duty resources.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: They can also recall and mobilise Police National Servicemen and tap on Volunteer Special Constabulary officers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: While Police resources could be stretched in managing multiple civil unrests, they remain committed to maintaining law and order, without compromising on response to urgent incidents.
